item.title: 【HD Live Performances】UPSCALE - Madonna ft. Sabrina Carpenter - "Bring Your love" - 4K AI Enhanced and Remastered Audio
item.description:
Hey everyone!

Just dropping by to share this remaster I made of Madonna and Sabrina Carpenter’s new track at Coachella, it turned out incredible. I restored the video to fix the pixelation from the livestream and bring back the details. For the audio, I remastered it in Pro Tools, separating the stems to process everything for more volume, punch, transients, and stereo width, just the way you guys like it. I’m also including the MP3.

Enjoy!
